subject.title: fix(security): add default pidsLimit for sandbox containers

question: Should OpenClaw make a positive Docker sandbox `pidsLimit` the default for existing unset configs, and what explicit opt-out/schema/docs/tests are required before that ships?
rationale: The hardening addresses a real source-reproducible security gap, but it changes an effective sandbox default for existing deployments and needs owner approval of the security-versus-compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Approve default with upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the default-on PID cap only after schema/type/docs/tests and real Docker proof show fresh, upgrade, and explicit override behavior.

options.title: Keep default unset
options.body: Preserve current upgrade behavior and document operator-configured `pidsLimit` instead of changing existing unset deployments.

options.title: Use an opt-in hardening mode
options.body: Introduce only a maintainer-approved strict profile or setting if owners want the mitigation without changing current defaults.

recommendation.title: Approve default with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the default-on PID cap only after schema/type/docs/tests and real Docker proof show fresh, upgrade, and explicit override behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The team owns the affected sandbox security boundary and docs surfaces in CODEOWNERS.
